outcome: Incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: The study included 1907 twin pregnancies with two live fetuses at 13 weeks of gestation.
finding: The administration of 160 mg aspirin daily significantly decreased the hazard ratio for preeclampsia (0.63) and HDP (0.56) in twin pregnancies, without increasing aspirin-related complications, unlike the 80-100 mg dose which showed no significant decrease.
followup_time: Until postpartum (covering pregnancy outcomes and postpartum hemorrhage)
gest_age: Included twin pregnancies with 2 live fetuses at 13 weeks of gestation; preeclampsia <34 WG was an outcome.
